name: Dr. Bernhard Kirchmair
headline: Group Vice President Digital Business @ DAX company Heidelberg Materials | Ex-CDO with VINCI (EURO STOXX 50) | Ex-Telefónica O2 | Ex-KPMG | CDTM | 3x Founder | Avid Traveller
summary:
Founded, built up and run two leading corporate Digital Units from scratch, both ranked among Top 3 of 300+ Digital Units in Germany (Capital Magazin 7/2021 and 7/2022 official rankings): One with Telefónica (Wayra), one with VINCI (VINCI Energies Digital). #digitalbusinessdevelopment #revenuegrowth #corporateinnovation

Employers & consulting clients include Allianz, BMW, Deutsche Telekom, Evonik, Heidelberg Materials, IBM, KPMG, Siemens, Telefónica, VINCI, Vodafone. Built up several new digital businesses End-to-End: product, operations, service. 

Experienced hands-on can-do senior executive with a demonstrated track record of delivering digital revenue growth and transformational change through business innovation, both in multi-national large corporate environments and local startups; in B2C and B2B; in product companies and service companies. 

People-focused, results-driven, blending analytical precision and intuitive business acumen. Passionate about technology advancement for purpose. Spent the better part of my working life exploring what a company needs to do today to still be relevant tomorrow.

Strong believer that the most important mark of a leader is the team she brings together and the cultural frame she establishes to encourage autonomy and collaboration, meaning and passion, learning and trust.

Educated at leading business and engineering schools in the US (UC Berkeley, Stanford), Asia (HKUST) and Europe (IMD, TUM, LMU). 

Collected moments, not things, in 97 countries across the globe.

positions.title: Group Vice President Digital Business & Partnerships
positions.description:
COMPANY PROFILE: 
DAX-listed company Heidelberg Materials is one of the world’s largest integrated manufacturers of building materials and solutions, with leading market positions in aggregates, cement, and ready-mixed concrete. Global footprint spans ~60 countries with 3.000 plants, 60.000 employees, 21.2bn rev in 2025.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Globally leading the Digital Transformation at Heidelberg Materials from a digital products, services and partnerships perspective. Help building world class value propositions to create the first industrial tech player in the industry. Reporting to Member of the Management Board. 

✚ Leading the Group‘s global Digital Business & Partnerships division and overseeing various delivery practices, including AI Omnichannel Engagement, Partnership Commercial/Investments, Customer Experience Strategy, Change Management & Digital Adoption.
✚ Driving growth and revenue generation from Heidelberg’s equity investments (e.g. Command Alkon, Giatec, Pathways) across North America, Europe and Australia with a strong emphasis on sustainability solutions: successfully launched the first non-building material product in the company’s 150-year history, achieving seven figure revs within 12 months across 25 countries 
✚ Transforming the company's global customer service function into an AI first operating model
✚ Overseeing and expanding Heidelberg’s portfolio of customer-focused digital portals and apps aiming to provide a seamless omnichannel experience: successfully increased user base from 17k to 40k+monthly active B2B users, establishing one of the largest customer platforms in the industry
✚ Running the Group's Venture Client Unit to build a leading cohesive digital ecosystem that delivers business and customer value for country operations and partners globally 
✚ Leading a portfolio of digitalization projects within complex supply chains across multiple countries
✚ Driving sales transformation projects in Europe & North America

positions.description:
COMPANY PROFILE:
Part of the Elite Network of Bavaria, the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM) is a joint institution of two of Germany's most prestigious and best universities, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM). CDTM focuses on cutting edge education and research in Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Product Management and the acceleration of start ups. With >100 industry partners (McKinsey, BMW, Vodafone, Siemens),13 partner universities (e.g. MIT, Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia, Waseda) and >90 startups evolved (e.g. Freeletics, Stylight, Outfittery), CDTM plays a key role in Germany's academic and entrepreneurship ecosystem.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

✚ As member of management team helped to secure single digit mEUR funding, acquired >20 industry partners, spin out >15 startups (e.g. Stylight, eGym), tripled employee base 
✚ Managed delivery of >30 online/mobile business incubation and innovation projects in partnerships with e.g. BMW, Deutsche Telekom, O2, Siemens, Vodafone and various startups
✚ Designed and gave lectures based on Harvard Business School Case Studies in areas such as Managing Product Development, Business Planning, Trend Analysis, Entrepreneurial Negotiation, Product Marketing
